goal: Integrate exact-head hosted CI inspection and fail-closed failure classification into the governed continuation path so success, pending checks, harness defects and product/runtime defect candidates are distinguished before any recovery or merge action.
scope: consume one exact selected PR head SHA and complete current-head workflow/check provider truth before deriving any CI decision
distinguish all-success, pending or in-progress, harness or validation defect, product/runtime defect candidate and provider/environment ambiguity without guessing
permit recovery planning only as read-only classification output; any rerun, branch mutation, runtime validation, merge or Issue-close remains under separate existing authority
preserve reusable Writer Lease, materialization and merge/Issue-close grants plus product/runtime bytes unchanged
fail closed on head drift, incomplete CI inventory, contradictory conclusions or inability to attribute a failure deterministically
keep CI inspection and classification hosted and read only
forbidden_scope: grant workflow-rerun, branch, provider-state, merge or Issue-close authority
mutate product/runtime source or runtime state
mutate ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: exact-head CI inventory is complete and bound to one immutable PR head SHA
success and pending states are deterministic and cannot be confused with failure recovery
failed checks are classified fail-closed with evidence sufficient to distinguish harness/governance defects from product/runtime defect candidates
recovery output grants no mutation authority and requires a separately authorized execution path
exact-head hosted CI passes with no provider-state, ADWF, product/runtime or 1080/1081 mutation
